title: 7.3.19.2 Installation: Timing Pulley replacement (taper lock bushing + pulley set screws)
summary: Loosely assemble the taper lock bushing into the timing pulley and align all three holes. Thread set screws into the two opposite holes (threads on the pulley half, smooth on the bushing half), then slip the assembly onto the shaft with keyway alignment (if present). Position the pulley 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face using a spacer and an 8-mm hex wrench. Tighten both opposite set screws in alternating small increments until the set screw torque reaches 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb). Reinstall top and/or bottom side panels if removed, then re-start the operator station.
when_to_use: Use this procedure to install the timing pulley using a taper lock bushing, align the keyway, set the pulley spacing from the gearbox pilot face to 8 mm (0.315 in.), and torque the pulley set screws to 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb).
safety_notes: This installation procedure is part of the Timing Pulley Replacement section. The associated timing pulley replacement figure and removal steps specify LOTO the tipper and side panel removal for access (see related evidence in this packet).
access_or_tools_needed: Spacer (between gearbox pilot face and pulley) to maintain 8 mm spacing
Torque tool capable of 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb)
Access to reinstall top and/or bottom side panels (if removed)

system_preconditions: Timing pulley replacement installation context: taper lock bushing and timing pulley are available for installation.
Operator station restart capability is available after side panels are reinstalled.
external_references: Starting The Operator Station (referenced within this section as the restart step target on page 66).

steps.title: Loosely assemble taper lock bushing into the pulley and align all three holes
steps.purpose: Establish correct initial alignment of the taper lock bushing and pulley before set screw threading and shaft installation.
steps.instruction: Loosely assemble the taper lock bushing into the pulley and align all three holes.
steps.expected_result: Taper lock bushing is seated in the pulley with all three holes aligned.
steps.healthy_condition: All three holes in the taper lock bushing/pulley interface are visibly aligned (no misalignment between bushing and pulley halves).
steps.failure_condition: Holes are not aligned (bushing/pulley halves appear offset), preventing correct set screw placement.

source_evidence.quote: 1. Loosely assemble the taper lock bushing into the pulley and align all three holes.

steps.title: Thread set screws into the two opposite holes with correct thread/smooth placement
steps.purpose: Ensure set screws are installed in the correct holes and oriented correctly across the pulley/bushing halves.
steps.instruction: Thread set screws into the two holes that are opposite each other. Confirm they have threads on the pulley half and are smooth on the bushing half.
steps.expected_result: Two set screws are threaded into the opposite holes with correct thread/smooth placement across pulley vs bushing halves.
steps.healthy_condition: Set screws show threaded engagement on the pulley half and smooth (non-threaded) portion on the bushing half.
steps.failure_condition: Set screws are installed in the wrong holes or the thread/smooth placement is reversed/mismatched.

actions.label: Thread set screws
actions.exact_action: Thread set screws into the two holes that are opposite each other.

actions.label: Verify thread/smooth placement
actions.exact_action: They will have threads on the pulley half and be smooth on the bushing half.

source_evidence.quote: 2. Thread set screws into the two holes that are opposite each other. They will have threads on the pulley half and be smooth on the bushing half.

steps.title: Slip assembly onto shaft with keyway alignment (if present)
steps.purpose: Seat the pulley/bushing assembly on the shaft while maintaining correct rotational alignment via the keyway.
steps.instruction: Slip the assembly onto the shaft with the keyway slot aligned with the gearbox shaft key (if present).
steps.expected_result: Assembly is seated on the shaft with keyway slot aligned to the gearbox shaft key (if present).
steps.healthy_condition: Keyway slot and gearbox shaft key are aligned (no visible rotational misalignment at the key interface).
steps.failure_condition: Keyway slot is not aligned with the gearbox shaft key, indicating incorrect rotational alignment.

actions.label: Seat assembly on shaft
actions.exact_action: Slip the assembly onto the shaft with the keyway slot aligned with the gearbox shaft key (if present).

source_evidence.quote: 3. Slip the assembly onto the shaft with the keyway slot aligned with the gearbox shaft key (if present).

steps.title: Set pulley position to 8 mm from gearbox pilot face using spacer
steps.purpose: Ensure correct axial spacing between the pulley and gearbox pilot face before final torqueing.
steps.instruction: Verify the final pulley position is 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face. Place a spacer between the gearbox pilot face and pulley to maintain the spacing. Use an 8-mm hex wrench for this task.
steps.expected_result: Pulley is positioned 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face using a spacer to maintain spacing.
steps.healthy_condition: Measured/verified gap equals 8 mm (0.315 in.) between gearbox pilot face and pulley, maintained by the spacer.
steps.failure_condition: Gap is not 8 mm (0.315 in.) or spacer cannot maintain the required spacing.

actions.label: Verify 8 mm gap
actions.exact_action: Verify the final position of the pulley should be 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face.

actions.label: Place spacer to maintain spacing
actions.exact_action: place a spacer between the gearbox pilot face and pulley to maintain the spacing

stop_or_escalate_if: If the pulley cannot be positioned to 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face using a spacer, stop and re-check alignment/spacing before proceeding to set-screw tightening.

source_evidence.quote: 4. Once tightened in place, the final position of the pulley should be 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face. We recommend placing a spacer between the gearbox pilot face and pul- ley to maintain the spacing. An 8-mm hex wrench can be used for this task.

steps.title: Tighten both opposite set screws in alternating increments to 5.6 Nm
steps.purpose: Secure the pulley/bushing assembly with correct torque while maintaining alignment and spacing.
steps.instruction: In small increments, tighten both set screws, alternating between them until the set screw torque reaches 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb).
steps.expected_result: Both opposite set screws are tightened to a torque of 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb) using alternating incremental tightening.
steps.healthy_condition: Torque tool indicates set screw torque reaches 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb) for both set screws after alternating incremental tightening.
steps.failure_condition: Set screw torque cannot be reached to 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb) after alternating incremental tightening.

actions.label: Alternating incremental tightening
actions.exact_action: In small increments, tighten both set screws, alternating between them until the set screw torque reaches 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb).

stop_or_escalate_if: If set screw torque cannot be reached to 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb) after alternating incremental tightening, stop and re-check set screw seating and assembly alignment.

source_evidence.quote: 5. In small increments, tighten both set screws, alternating between them until the set screw torque reaches 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb).

success_criteria: Timing pulley assembly is seated with keyway alignment (if present).
Pulley is positioned 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face using a spacer.
Both opposite set screws are tightened to 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb).
Top and/or bottom side panels are reinstalled (if removed).
healthy_conditions: Gap between gearbox pilot face and pulley is 8 mm (0.315 in.) and maintained by spacer during torqueing.
Torque tool indicates set screw torque reaches 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb) after alternating incremental tightening.
failure_conditions: Pulley cannot be positioned to 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face using a spacer.
Set screw torque cannot be reached to 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb) after alternating incremental tightening.
Keyway alignment is incorrect (if keyway/key is present).
Side panels are not reinstalled when removed.
Operator station does not restart successfully.
escalation_guidance: If the pulley cannot be positioned to 8 mm (0.315 in.) from the gearbox pilot face using a spacer, stop and re-check alignment/spacing before proceeding to set-screw tightening.
If set screw torque cannot be reached to 5.6 Nm (49.5 in-lb) after alternating incremental tightening, stop and re-check set screw seating and assembly alignment.
